title.zh: CFTC Wants to Drop Gemini’s $5M Settlement. A Judge Just Said No
title.en: CFTC Wants to Drop Gemini’s $5M Settlement. A Judge Just Said No

current_state.zh: Judge Alvin Hellerstein denied a joint motion by the CFTC and Gemini to vacate the exchange's January 2025 $5 million settlement, leaving the paid fine and a permanent injunction barring false statements to the regulator in place.
current_state.en: Judge Alvin Hellerstein denied a joint motion by the CFTC and Gemini to vacate the exchange's January 2025 $5 million settlement, leaving the paid fine and a permanent injunction barring false statements to the regulator in place.
